context: First usable OpenCode Go vertical, deliberately the Codex/Responses one: the ProviderAdapter contract is Responses-shaped and the transport is chat-completions, so no protocol round-trip is involved and a defect here is an adapter defect rather than a translation defect.
root_causes: No OpenCode Go adapter existed; G3 fixed the credential, catalog and endpoint facts but deliberately shipped no ProviderAdapter.

The inherited chat-completions streaming transport raises the DeepSeek error type on any non-2xx, so a quota refusal on the streaming path would surface as a generic 502 attributed to the wrong provider with the 429 dropped.
Codex sizes its context management from the model listing, so a listing without per-model context windows makes the client compact at the wrong point.
evidence: KimiAdapter(DeepSeekAdapter) is the established precedent for a chat-completions provider reusing the transport and overriding only credentials, base URL and listing.
DeepSeekAdapter._call_upstream_stream raises DeepSeekError on a non-2xx before any SSE byte is read, which a subclass inherits verbatim.
ResponsesGatewayApp raises ValueError on any adapter prefix absent from APP_PROVIDER_PREFIXES, so registering an adapter without allowlisting its prefix breaks boot for every provider.
normalize_headroom_provider maps any provider outside _PROVIDER_KEYS to 'other', which would make this backend's Headroom behaviour unattributable.
The headroom v2 governed provider map is asserted exactly in two places (a fixture and test_client_convergence_contract), a deliberate double-entry tripwire on widening it.
models.dev exposes a dedicated opencode-go provider block covering 28 of the 29 live ids with context and output limits; the sole gap, hy3-preview, is also upstream-unavailable.
solutions: Subclass DeepSeekAdapter for the transport and override only credentials, headers, base URL, listing and error taxonomy.
Override _call_upstream_stream so a streamed non-2xx raises the OpenCode error type, and a 429 raises OpenCodeQuotaError carrying status and payload for verbatim surfacing.
Send Authorization: Bearer plus a User-Agent on dispatch, and no credential at all on the public GET /models path.
Enrich the listing from a committed models.dev snapshot, omitting limits for unknown ids rather than guessing a window.
Register on the Responses gateway only, allowlist the prefix, add a real Headroom provider dimension, and assert by negative test that the Anthropic surface is untouched.
acceptance_criteria: The adapter satisfies the frozen ProviderAdapter protocol and reaches /opencode/v1/responses.
Unary and streaming both map to canonical Responses shapes.
Dispatch carries the bearer credential and a User-Agent, and targets the zen/go base.
A missing credential raises before any upstream request is issued.
A 429 raises a quota error carrying status 429 and a payload, on both the unary and streaming paths, with exactly one attempt and no fallback.
A streamed non-2xx is attributed to OpenCode, not to the inherited transport's provider.
An upstream error never echoes the credential.
The listing carries per-model context windows where known and omits them where not, reports live versus fallback provenance, and needs no credential.
Headroom resolves a real provider dimension rather than collapsing to 'other'.
No OpenCode route is reachable on the Anthropic surface in this goal.
legacy_risk_reason: extends the shared Responses gateway prefix allowlist, the adapter registry and the governed Headroom provider map; a regression breaks boot for every provider rather than only this one
